title: Sunspot Watch
text:
☀️ Sunspot Watch — October 11, 2026

NOAA Active Region 4551 stands out on the visible solar disk today as a particularly prominent sunspot group.

📍 Location: S15E48
☀️ Region: AR 4551
🔥 Recent activity: 1 C-class flare

Sunspots noted! ☀️

Sunspots are cooler, magnetically active regions of the solar surface and are often associated with solar flares and other activity.

Image: N/A
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center + NASA SDO
